bio: An elegant restaurant with a lovely, light-filled winter garden and a delightful outdoor space – the latter is all the more appealing for being discreetly located within a beautiful inner courtyard. The kitchen serves classic Italian dishes, crafted from high-quality produce – the pasta is a particular highlight! The enthusiastic front-of-house team is friendly and attentive. You will also see the chef himself making his way around the restaurant and chatting with diners....
